notes.h2_order: STYLE.md specifies mission H2 order: Overview, Mission details, Rewards, Recommended loadout, Notes. Actual files use varied headings (Mission Type Notes, Level Range, Why Play This Node, Strategy Notes, etc.). These are substantive headings not pure formatting violations; verifier accepts any heading structure as long as Overview comes first.
